text:
Some people are young and nothing more

some people are old and nothing more.

And some people are in the middle

only in the middle.

And if flies wore clothes

and all the buildings burned in

golden fire,

if the sky shook like

a belly dance

and all the atomic bombs began to

scream,

some people would be young and nothing more

and some people would be old and nothing more

and the rest would be the same,

the rest would be the same.

The few who are different

are eliminated pretty quickly

by the police, by their mothers, their

brothers, and others

by themselves.

What remains is what

you see

it is hard.

translation.title: Some People Are Young and Nothing More...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the flat repetition and the hard closing diagnosis of ordinary sameness.
